results.title: Vertiginous
results.overview: Jacques goes to his friend Bruno's house to tell him some big news: the entire human race is living in a simulation...

results.title: The Cure
results.overview: An adopted 16-year-old with a mysterious illness learns her bio-tech billionaire parents are harvesting her blood for nefarious purposes.

results.title: Mikael: Hunter of Two Realms
results.overview: An elite police officer who is also a jinn hunter, facing the threat of creatures from the supernatural while investigating a series of gruesome murders leading to an epic battle against the Jinn King for the sake of balance between the two worlds.

results.title: Winkle Twinkle
results.overview: An idealistic political activist returns to a world that has changed beyond recognition, forcing him to confront the clash between his long-held beliefs and modern realities. Torn between family, ideology, and his own sense of identity, he embarks on a deeply personal journey of self-discovery and change.

results.title: Sambung Silaturahmi
results.overview: A comedy drama about human characters who are often selfish and prioritize their own interests, yet sometimes forget to empathize and open their hearts to reconnect and build meaningful relationships with the people around them.

results.title: Champagne
results.overview: When Maarten learns that his father, Hans, is terminally ill, he decides to take him on one last road trip to the Champagne region.

results.title: Gayong 2
results.overview: Following the end of the Japanese Occupation of Malaya, former officer Meor joins Singapore's Special Branch to take on ruthless Chinese triads that run the opium trade under the protection of corrupt officials.

results.title: In Gran Segreto: Un Racconto Familiare su Giorgio Bassani
results.original_title: In Gran Segreto: Un Racconto Familiare su Giorgio Bassani

results.title: The Great Skull
results.overview: Gu Liyan, on the verge of graduating from university, suddenly faced her father's death and had to assist her sharp-witted mother in navigating the tedious funeral arrangements. Unexpectedly, the 'Funeral Affairs Committee' secretly organized by her father before his death suddenly arrived at their doorstep... With unanticipated guests, absurd situations, and ridiculously dramatic events, the mother-daughter duo urgently needed to gather their strength to confront it all.

results.title: Glitterbomb
results.overview: Minutes into Lee's virtual job interview, glitter begins pouring out of her inexplicably. Although she does her best to carry on with the meeting, tiny, shiny particles are cascading out of her, pooling at her bare feet, and engulfing her toes. In this too-surreal moment, Lee must acknowledge the shiny, shimmering elephant in the room, or else risk being buried in a mound of unresolved issues... and glitter.

results.title: Molly
results.overview: A chance encounter at a launderette sparks a meaningful connection between Vinnie and Ryan. As closeness blurs into desire, they are forced to confront what love demands before it fractures everything they have built.

results.title: De souche
results.overview: As immigration becomes more central than ever in political discourses, De souche offers a dizzying deep dive into the far-reaching tentacles of the “Great Replacement” conspiracy theory, which is gaining popularity across the Western world. In this illuminating documentary, journalist and filmmaker Simon Coutu travels across Québec and France, meeting a range of people who subscribe to or specialize in the subject. He examines the origins of this rhetoric, its harmful consequences, and its ties to the far right and white supremacist movements. A hard-hitting documentary that offers an essential critical perspective.

results.title: Je so’ pazzo
results.overview: Je so’ pazzo is an intense portrait of Pino Daniele—a rebellious soul born in the alleys of Naples who revolutionized Italian music by blending blues, jazz, and Neapolitan tradition. The film chronicles his rise, from a childhood marked by abandonment to his legendary 1981 concert before a crowd of 200,000. Amidst family conflicts, personal vulnerabilities, and deep loves, Pino finds a musical language to express what words cannot. Yet success brings new challenges: an unresolved relationship with his father, the burden of expectations, and the risk of repeating past mistakes. It is not merely the story of an extraordinary musician, but that of a man grappling with himself, seeking reconciliation with his roots and the love of a city that never stopped waiting for him.

results.title: Desert Ed
results.overview: After the passing of his longtime teammate on the reality TV Show Battlebots, robot engineer Edward Robinson moves out to the desert, where he reflects on his career and adapts a new hermetic lifestyle.

results.title: I Know Who You Are
results.overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

results.title: Three Wishes of Cinderella
results.overview: In this magical, funny twist on Cinderella, a woodcutter transformed into a chipmunk, a nut-granting tree, and true love help her escape a forced royal wedding.

results.title: Poppy McCorn
results.overview: Your favorite hot-buttered movie mascot welcomes you to the theater, and reminds you to be quiet and courteous...or else...

results.title: The Pastor Who Preys
results.overview: Budding fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. When Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off.
